title: Singam Puli
desc: Siva is a hardworking fisherman whose brother, Ashok, is a notorious lawyer and womaniser. When he kills a girl, Siva drags him to court. However, Ashok uses his skills to get himself out.

title: Kaadhal Azhivathillai
desc: Vallavan, from a modest background, falls for Charmy, the daughter of a powerful minister, but their love faces intense opposition, leading to a battle against family pressures.

title: Sooriyan
desc: Sooriyan, an intelligent security officer, is forced to hide his identity and take refuge in a remote village after he is accused of murdering the central minister.

title: Satyam
desc: Satyam is a budding writer who is always misunderstood by his father. As he struggles to make a mark professionally, his personal life goes through a surprising turn.

title: Sakalakala Vallavan
desc: Shakti learns that the girl he loves, Anjali, is the cousin of his arch nemesis. Subsequently, his family tries to split them apart by compelling him to wed Divya.
